note: Ladunek dla custom-provider webhooka inbox_ops. Kazdy element tablicy to cale body POST-a. Naglowki x-webhook-timestamp i x-webhook-signature liczy sender (HMAC SHA256 z 'timestamp.rawBody', sekret INBOX_OPS_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Adres 'to' wybiera tenanta, wiec musi byc rowny inbox_settings.inbox_address.
